facts.fact: The Health Care Providers Association of Nigeria launched HCPAN Connect, a platform meant to let providers, HMOs, regulators, government and patients exchange and aggregate health data in a central repository, to roll out from Lagos to other cities.
The HMCAN chairman said health data in Nigeria is fragmented across systems that do not speak to one another, with no point of connection.

systems.owner: Health Care Providers Association of Nigeria
systems.tiers: private providers, HMOs, regulators; Lagos first

note: as_of is the published date; the launch date is not stated.
